title: Open a new service while a training area remains unavailable
description: A fictional terminal program has a fixed public opening date. The complete baggage training area becomes available late, so the team proposes replacing the joint exception-handling rehearsal with separate departmental briefings.
decision_requested: Recommend a readiness disposition, a feasible integrated trial, and an operational fallback with named decision roles.
constraints: No passenger or baggage throughput target is supplied.
You may propose reduced initial scope but must state its service consequences.
Do not invent trial success or historical airport metrics.
